screening_decisions.reason: This is a before-and-after quasi-experimental study comparing PHC villages with non-PHC villages, not a randomised controlled trial. The study design does not meet the RCT requirement.
While this is a randomized controlled trial, it tests malaria chemoprophylaxis administered by TBAs, not TBA training. The intervention is the drug, not the training of TBAs.
This is an observational study comparing three groups (trained TBA, tetanus toxoid, control) without randomisation. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a field trial comparing intervention and control areas, not a randomised controlled trial. The study design does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a Cochrane review protocol, not a primary study. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis bias detection, not a study of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a validation study of a survey instrument, not an RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
While this is a randomized trial, it compares two teaching methods (lecture vs interactive) for TBAs, not trained vs untrained TBAs. Does not meet the comparison criteria.
This is a field trial with intervention and control villages, not a randomised controlled trial. The study design does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a controlled study comparing communities with and without trained TBAs, but not described as randomised. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a review of a meta-analysis, not a primary RCT. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a cluster randomised controlled trial comparing trained TBAs (intervention: neonatal resuscitation training + amoxicillin) vs control TBAs (standard care). Meets all selection criteria.
This is a review article summarizing systematic reviews and meta-analyses, not a primary RCT. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a retrospective case series from a teaching hospital, not an RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a time-series experimental study, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the RCT requirement.

This is a cluster-randomized controlled trial comparing intervention talukas (trained TBAs with delivery kits, linked to health services) vs control talukas (usual care). Meets all selection criteria.

While this is a cluster-randomised controlled trial, the intervention is women's groups, not TBA training. All clusters received basic TBA training, so there is no comparison of trained vs untrained TBAs.
This is a systematic review of maternal death causes, not a primary RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a quasi-experimental design (before/after with intervention and non-intervention communities), not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
While this is a cluster randomised controlled trial, the intervention is breastfeeding promotion, not TBA training. Does not meet the comparison criteria.
This is a longitudinal study with intervention and comparison areas, not described as randomised. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a community-based observational study comparing delivery settings, not an RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a policy document/meeting report from the Safe Motherhood Initiative, not a primary RCT. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a qualitative study about identity work in occupations (based on Episcopal priests), not an RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
While this is a community randomized trial, the intervention is nutrition counselling through multiple channels (including TBAs), not TBA training. Does not meet the comparison criteria.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis tests, not a study of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.

This includes a cluster-randomized controlled trial component (Neonatal Resuscitation Program) comparing trained birth attendants vs control clusters. Meets the selection criteria for RCT comparing trained vs untrained birth attendants.
This is a validation study of women's recall of obstetric complications, not an RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a cross-sectional survey of TBAs' knowledge, attitudes, and practices, not an RCT. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a controlled study with intervention and non-intervention areas, but not described as randomised. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
This is a review/commentary article about neonatal mortality, not a primary RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.

While this is a cluster randomised trial, the intervention is delivered through Lady Health Workers (LHWs) working with TBAs, not specifically TBA training. The comparison is intervention package vs routine care, not trained vs untrained TBAs.
This is a validation study of verbal autopsy methodology, not an RCT of TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
